voice-statement-no-interpretation.notes: The proposition .md mixes the formal four-part statement with extensive physical interpretation (Higgs mechanism, gravity, force-operator table); much of this interpretive prose would belong in linked remarks.

fit-section-chapter.notes: Cohomological embedding / H^1(Σ4) torus-knot basis is core Ch 7 cohomological-defect content.

wall-side-statement.notes: Statement is cohomological/combinatorial; Lean over ℕ/Fin, no gratuitous ℝ in the substantive claim (seifertRank, embeddable are Nat).

wall-side-proof.notes: No narrative **Proof.** body; argument is in the .lean existence construction.

proof-narrative-lean-equiv.notes: The .md proposition has four substantive parts (embeddability=representation iff, fiber degree, Jones-polynomial SPANNING/rank-5 completeness, genus-4 forced); the Lean only constructs a structure with genus=4 and a stored spanning_rank=5 field — the rank-5 spanning (part iii) is asserted as a structure field (spanning_rank_eq := rfl), not proved, so the Lean is materially weaker than the narrative completeness claim.

proof-statement-integrity.notes: Completeness (part iii, the 6x5 character matrix has rank 5) is encoded as a hand-set structure field, not derived; the existence theorem trivially satisfies it by rfl. The substantive spanning claim is not formalized.

proof-no-self-assuming-projection.notes: The existence theorem builds an explicit witness, not a projection of a field equal to the conclusion; genus/rank are constructed, not assumed via a field typed as the conclusion.

proof-no-trivial-true.notes: The theorem's two conjuncts (genus=4, spanning_rank=5) are satisfied by construction (the witness sets both literally), so the existence claim is near-trivial; the genuine content (rank-5 spanning) is parked in an unproved structure field rather than the goal.

proof-no-false-premise.notes: all_embeddable is genuinely discharged (fin_cases/omega) and the coprimality witnesses (by decide) hold; no false premise.

proof-no-unused-hypotheses.notes: The existence theorem takes no hypotheses; all_embeddable field is actually verified per knot.

proof-no-decide-masking.notes: decide here discharges only finite coprimality facts (legitimate), but the deeper spanning_rank=5 content is rfl on a hand-set field rather than a decided/derived computation — the rank-5 character-matrix claim is asserted, not checked.

da-false-claim.notes: Checked: H_2(q) has 2 irreps, H_3(q) has 3 (incl. 2-dim standard); 2+3=5 irreps; χ=1-8+1=-6; (r-1)(s-1)≤8 set correct. The dim count of H_3 = 6 = 3! is right. No false statement.

da-vacuous.notes: The Lean existence theorem is close to vacuous: it constructs a structure whose genus and spanning_rank are set to the target literals, so the conjuncts hold by rfl; the load-bearing completeness (rank-5 spanning of the 6x5 character matrix) is a stored number, not a proved fact.

da-circular.notes: No calibration back-fit; g=4 is the cohomological output of χ=-6, used consistently.

da-overclaim.evidence: cohomological-embedding.md:179: "There are exactly 7 force operators (including free propagation), and we prove there can be no others."
da-overclaim.notes: 'we prove there can be no others' overstates: the no-8th-force argument rests on the embeddability bound (proved) but the interpretive force-operator identification and the spanning/completeness (part iii) are not formally proved — the Lean stores rank-5 rather than proving it.

da-hidden-dof.notes: No off-menu numerical coefficient; knot-particle/force assignments are labels on the fixed 6 embeddable knots.

da-non-sequitur.notes: Core chain (embeddability bound -> 6 knots -> 5 irreps span) is coherent; the 17>8 overlap caveat is correctly handled (per-knot rank ≤4).

da-lean-narrative-divergence.evidence: cohomological-embedding.lean:101-118: existence theorem stores spanning_rank=5 (rfl) instead of proving the 6x5 character matrix has rank 5
da-lean-narrative-divergence.notes: The .md's central completeness claim (part iii: Jones evaluations span the 5-dim irrep space, 'rank 5 verified numerically') is NOT what the Lean proves — Lean only exhibits a structure with the number 5 written into a field; the spanning theorem is unformalized.

da-citation-misuse.notes: jones1987 (Markov trace/link polynomials) and kassel1995 (Hecke rep theory) are correctly attributed for the irrep/Jones machinery.

da-definitional-ambiguity.notes: Seifert rank, fiber degree, irrep, q-dimension are defined; 'knot basis' and Hodge split are described concretely.

da-empirical-fragility.notes: The rank-5 claim is backed only by an inline 'verified numerically' with no witness file or reproducible script referenced; can't audit the numerical check.

da-physical-implausibility.notes: Higgs/gravity identifications are interpretive; g_A≈1.277 and Vol(4_1)=2.0299 are consistent with the corpus; no broken conservation/units.

da-reproducibility.notes: No witness JSON / script hash backs the numerical rank check; reproducibility of the spanning claim cannot be verified from the block.

da-referee-verdict.notes: Mathematically the embeddability/irrep counts are correct, but the headline completeness ('span', 'exactly 7 forces, proved') outruns the formalization, which only stores rank-5 as a field.
